summary: The traffic issue finally boiled over. After Derrek's 'next 48 hrs' promise on Aug 4 lapsed with no update, Vicky chased twice on Aug 10 and for the first time framed it as a two-month failure with results 'getting worse and worse'. Derrek replied the same day that the system is live and apologised, but by Aug 11 she was reporting that her second page (mermaidua) had gone days with no new fans, and that message never got a substantive answer. The July 15-31 invoice was paid on Aug 11 after two more nudges (Aug 9 and Aug 11) — the third invoice in a row that needed chasing. On the plus side she completed three Snapchat adds the same day they were asked, delivered Reddit and IG reel content proactively, and flagged that the $1k custom will land in 5-6 days because she is travelling. Jake's $700 call (sold Jul 3) and the whale list promised Jun 30 both went another week without a single mention from the team.

health.rationale: Down from 70. The traffic complaint escalated from a polite check-in to an explicit two-month grievance after Derrek's 48-hour commitment was missed by six days; a new 'no fans on my second page' report went unanswered; and Jake's $700 undelivered call plus the whale list stayed untouched for another week. Offsetting positives: the outstanding invoice was paid, and she stayed fast and cooperative on every task the team asked of her.
